P-ENCLOSURE.evidence: The garden features a defined edge with a pool and a wall, but lacks overhead enclosure. The side is partially enclosed by a building and trees, creating a semi-enclosed space.

P-LAYERS.evidence: Olive trees form the tree layer, with a continuous grass ground cover beneath. No distinct shrub layer is visible between them, resulting in only two clear planting layers.

P-FOCAL.evidence: The illuminated dining area with pendant lights serves as a clear focal point, drawing the eye and organizing the surrounding garden and pool space.
